experiment: XFeat-ONNX dense end-to-end matching with local affine DIC initialization

model.license: Apache-2.0 as declared by the ONNX export repository; upstream XFeat is Apache-2.0

runtime.timed_region: Inference and per-radius local-affine fit are timed separately; image decoding is excluded.

input.visible_seed_rule: only source centers with analytically in-bounds target centers are scored

data.stress_case: synthetic global affine 60% tensile extrapolation; not a heterogeneous strain field
